prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.ts and use a named export.
Required API: export function collapseRuns(values: readonly number[]): number[]
Behavior: Return one value for each maximal adjacent run. Preserve order, do not mutate input, and return a non-null empty collection for empty input.
Visible example: [2,2,1,1,2] becomes [2,1,2].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

known_bad.code: export function collapseRuns(v:readonly number[]):number[]{return v.length?[v[0]]:null as unknown as number[]}
known_bad.label: null-empty-and-truncation

reference.code: export function collapseRuns(v:readonly number[]):number[]{const out:number[]=[];for(const x of v)if(!out.length||!Object.is(out[out.length-1],x))out.push(x);return out}
reference.label: author-reference
